decision.summary: No fully confirmed temporary offset interval is identifiable: the apparent platform in E/U from 510 onward lacks a clear opposing return within allowed context [510,699]; the sharp N drop/E surge near 588–589 coincides with ongoing elevated motion, not an isolated transient. All candidate intervals are uncertain due to ambiguous or absent recovery.

intervals.observation: E and U elevated (E ~1.5–3.5, U ~0.5–3.3) from index 510 onward; N fluctuates between -0.7 and -2.8 until ~580, then drops sharply to ~-3.0 at 588–589 while E surges to ~6.3 at 588. No clear opposing return observed within allowed context (up to 699); recovery ambiguous due to sustained high E/U and continued N depression beyond 589.

From ~590 to 664, E remains elevated (~3.5–6.3), U stays high (~1.5–4.8), and N remains depressed (~-1.5 to -3.3). No reversal or return toward pre-510 baseline levels observed; motion appears sustained rather than temporary. No confirmed offset termination before 664.
